/paper.bible/: Product name. Never translate. Keep the surrounding slashes when the source has them.
Bible: Use the locale's standard word for the Christian scriptures.
design: A saved document configuration owned by the user. Keep one consistent noun across the whole UI.
version: An immutable rendered snapshot of a design. Must stay distinct from "design".
booklet: A folded-and-stapled print format. Use the locale's bookbinding term.
cover: The wraparound book cover (front, spine and rear).
